You return to Mountain View without trouble.  With the Griloch threat gone for now, a huge party is thrown in your honor.  The entire village pours out to meet and thank you.  You are knee deep in revelry when Hodar pulls you aside.  "I Thank you..

...for giving my peple hope.  I pray I will not have to call upon you again, but I fear I might.  Thank you for saving my people this day."  You return to the party and receive the adoration of all of Mountain View for days on end.
Would you like to return to the surface?
You easily locate the Griloch treasure stash.  Some treasure!!!!  Make that lots of treasure.
A trap door leads down.  Will you enter?

"Enough already.  Please, I know of your mission.  Continue with it.  But know I can be of little help.  Here, maybe this will help you in some way."  Hodar pulls out a leather sack and hands it to you.
"I cannot speak of such things, and you would be wise to do the same."  Hodar looks down at his desk.  "You may go."  I will be here later if you need me.
The mayors aid meets you, "Mayor Hodar is not here at present.  Please return later."  He bids you good day.
This door is locked on this side.  Would you like to open it?
As you may have expected, some pretty nasty creatures are after you.
The lair of the Shantiles provides some needed cash!
No luck.  You have been out-played!  You lose 100 gp.
So close.  4 skulls!  You lose 100 gold.
Not a chance.  1 Skull.  -100 gold.
2 Skulls.  You lose 100 gold.
You don't have the gold?  Get outta here!  And take Riter with you!!  Riter looks disgusted!  You leave.
Marnin smiles?  Play again?
Who will play?
Winner!  5 skulls!  You collect 100 gold.
You collect 5 skulls.  Collect 100 gold.
Collect 100 gold.  5 Skulls.

A stately man answers the door.  Dressed in a dark green cloak, adorned with the crest of roses.  Fully bearded with a thick moustache, this mans strength flows from him.  He speaks, "Welcome, my name is Retyu.  Thyrr has told me you will come....
....to summon me to your aid.  I will be there when I am needed."  He shuts the door and you go on your way.
You cannot hear anything from behind the thick oaken door.
A thin but muscular man stops you.  "I am not one who allows common ruffians to enter my abode.  Now leave this place and act properly."  He slams the door.
The man answers the door again.  "I warned you once.  Now you answer to my steel."  He attacks.
You have killed Retyu the Ranger.  One of the most respected men in his profession.  The Gods will not be pleased.
A small, abandoned house.  It is empty.
A tall man answers the door.  "I will be there when needed.  Please let me be in peace."  He shuts the door.

A tall, skinny man runs out of the house before you can even knock.  "Yes, yes, I'll be there.  You can count me in.  Now go, go, I must study.  Go on.  Go.  Bye."  As quickly as he ran out, he runs back in and shuts the door.
The old man runs back out.  "Oh yeah, forgot.  Here.  You need this."  He hands you a map.
You here things crashing to the ground from behind the walls as the small man curses someone or something named Skinner for smashing one of his experiments.
A secret cave.  Inside is a treasure stash.
A large beast is feasting on a badger type creature.  He spots you and gets even hungrier.
Deep beneath the bones and offal you discover some coin.
Three large beasts eye you as you enter their lair.  They attack on sight.
As you approach this large chest it reveals its illusion.  An immense beast attacks.
As you strike down the beast, it reverts back to its chest shape.
A guardian awaits here.  He attacks.
After killing the beast, you can scoop up his weapon.
Leaving the castle now would disgrace the  minotaurs and leave them no choice but to join with the Griloch.  Are you going to leave the castle?
You have disgraced the Minotaurs by accepting to talk peace and then leaving them at the table.  They escort you out the door and throw you into the wilderness.  They will now be with the Griloch.
You stop short of the stairs and look over your shoulder.  You see Kayvon waving you over toward a large table against the east wall.
This deep cave is very forboding.  Will you enter?

Well, I warned you.  Several ugly beasts scurry around in front of you.  Atop a book of reddish hue lounges a black spider with a red underbelly.  These creatures of ill temperment attack on sight, with the black spider leading the charge.
After defeating the spider guardians, you retrieve the reddish book.
An empty cave, littered with the carcases of spiders.

"You are not yet ready for salvation, but then again, no one ever is.  You do not need me to save this town.  I will be with you as time progresses for this matter is not going to be resolved by simply dispatching the evil Griloch....."
A huge iron door hangs open.
You traverse the cleared path back to the other side.

Mayor Hodar is sitting at his desk.  He listens to your story of adventure and leans forward, "I see.  This is obviously very important.  I will get right on it immediately."  He leans back and continues working.  He doesn't seem to....
....understand the importance or graveness of his current plight.
Mayor Hodar is currently not here.
Hodar is in a meetng with the Berhune clerics at the present.  He can see no visitors.

Mayor Hodar shows you in.  "Good people.  It pains me that my people are living in fear.  We must do something.  I have discovered that the Griloch are the ones behind this.  Seek them out!!!!"  He ushers you out.
Hodar is currently meeting with a man named Thyrr.  He cannot be disturbed.
Hodar is currently meeting with a woman named Safeera.  He cannot be disturbed.
A secret cave is empty save for a small stone.
Hodar sits back and laughs.  "You are a gutsy bunch.  I like that."  He walks off.
The inner compound of the minotaurs.

Please register your copy of Prelude To Pestilence.  I know you hate this part, but I gotta make a living.  Thank you for supporting Fantasoft and the shareware idea!  -Sean Sayrs, Author of Prelude To Pestilence.
A hole has been dug in the earth.  Would you like to investigate?
Nothing is down there.  Just a six foot pit.  That is all, nothing else.  Sometimes there are just holes in the ground.
Mountain View.
A few Griloch champions wander through the door to the east.  Thyrr exclaims, "Ahh, a chance to prove our mettle in combat my old friends!"  He moves in for the attack.  You join him.

Thyrr stops.  "Behind these doors are the Griloch troops.  Prepare yourselves now friends, for once we open these doors......", Thyrr simply shakes his head and looks skyward for guidance.  Are you ready to open the doors now?
Seeing the tremendous mess, it appears someone was preparing for a great battle here.
Bodies litter the area.

A large covered wagon pulls up next to you.  A burly man of considerable girth waddles down from the seat and speaks.  "I've got some items here you might want.  Care to look around?  My prices are reasonable."  You may shop if you like.
Congratulations on defeating the Griloch.  You may wander around if you wish.  I'm sure they would like to see you back in Mountain View!  There is a portal here.  Would you like to step into it?

Thank you for playing Prelude To Pestilence.  Only by receiving support from people like you who took the time to register can we at Fantasoft continue to produce products such as this.  Please watch for the next Prelude To..................
...Pestilence scenario.  It should be out by October of '95.    Thanks for playing! -------Sean Sayrs, author.
After defeating Griloch you are free to wander around.  Congratulations!
An eerie feeling befalls you as you pass by this area.
A dragons den is in front of you.
You surprise a large patrol of Griloch Guards.  "Have at you.....the Berhune raiders attack violently."  You join them!
"Excellent work men!  We have prevailed.  This has been a great victory for our cause!"  The Berhune men sneak back to the camp.  "We will meet with you back at the commanders office!"  They leave.
Terderas is hard at work.  He mutters something about "Die, Griloch!" and continues with his work.  He is obviously too busy to speak with you.

Terderas looks indifferent.  He nods, then speaks in a monotone voice, "Fine.  I understand.  You have reservations.  Please, enjoy our hospitality while my men (his voice is no longer monotone) risk thier lives to (he is screaming) save the...
...city from (he is now a very interesting shade of bright crimson) the evil Griloch!"  He turns and leaves.
The door to the castle is old and ominous.  Strange sounds are heard from within.  Would you like to enter?

The doors swing open easily.  You feel peace and harmony reign.  The inside of the ancient castle is remarkable.  Beautiful stone walls and a white marble floor shine like new.  You close the door behind you and the mystery voices cease.
Would you like to leave the castle?
A group of thieves led by an orc have wandered into this castle.  They attack.
As you try to enter the door, it mysteriously slams shut in your face.  You cannot gain entrance.

A thunderous voice cries out, "There will be no fighting inside these holy walls.  You will have to resolve your petty differences elsewhere."  You feel a stinging sensation as you are teleported from this place.
"Welcome, my Berhune brothers.  How may I be of service?"

A man dressed in flowing white and light blue robes is studying over a candle.  He looks up at you.  "You are the chosen ones.  You will start on the path to save humankind.  You need help.  Seek ye the right path and find that help."  The man...
...returns to his studies.
"You have chosen.....poorly."  A huge claw materializes out of the air and rakes across the party.
A sign on the door reads, "The hall of hope(lessness)."  Will you enter?
The door swings open at the sliightest touch.  A blast of stale, dry air annoys your senses as you peer into the hall.  Untouched for countless years, dust is a full quarter inch thick.
"You have chosen.....wisely."
When this door is touched, the entire complex begins to shake.  "You have chosen the incorrect door, you now must leave this place before it collapses."  You do not have much time!
When you touch this door, it explodes.
When you touch this door, a man in white and light blue robes appears.  "You have chosen wisely.  Take these gifts so they may aid you in your quest."  His image fades.  You gaze upon your discovery.
The walls start crumbling around you.  You have not made it out in time.  The entire castle collapses upon itself and is destroyed, taking you with it.
A pair of cleric apparitions dressed in white and light blue robes float down the hallway, and pass right through you.
A small child carrying an inscense burner seemingly walks out of the wall in front of you.  She turns to you, winks and walks into the other wall.
A man appears in flowing white and light blue robes points west.  "Seek the correct path."  He fades away into the stone.
The floors shimmer white and the walls are perfectly cut stone.
You have made it to the door.  You can leave now with your lives, or stay and see what happens.  Do you wish to leave?
The castle collapses and you barely escape with your lives.  It is totally destroyed and cannot be entered ever again.
This once magnificent castle is now completely collapsed.  No one can enter it.
This door leads outside.  Would you like to exit?
Thyrr is not here.
Hidden in a small bush is some treasure.
A small man materializes before your very eyes.  He accuses you of stealing his ring and attacks you.  He transforms himself into a hideous creature.
Having defeated this wretch you have the pick of his belongings.

You discover a small child huddled and coughing in some tall grass.  She looks up at you with tears in her eyes.  "I'm hungry."  Do you feed her?

This small town seems deserted.  All of the houses have large bows of blue silk tied on the front door.  No home shows activity except the farthest one.  Smoke billows out of the chimney and light pours out the windows.

The small community is gathered at this home.  They are holding a meeting discussing the loss of one of their own.  You overhear a small girl has been missing for several days.  She was last seen heading toward the dreaded Fingertip.....

...mountains.  One older gentleman speaks, "I have been saving something very special to me for my entire life.  Given to me by my father who received it from his father before him, I offer it to whomever will join in the quest to find my....
....beloved daughter.  Who will join?"  Several men look away as they know the fear and danger she is in.  No one volunteers.  Will you step forward?

"Excellent.  You are brave men indeed, and strangers as well."  He scans the lowered heads of the others and speaks.  "It does not speak well to the character of this town when strangers must look after one of our own."  He turns to you, "I will....
